# Roleplay Rule 5 - Play as a believable character
Remember to treat this game like a round of DND, play a believable character and stick with it.
## Examples
### [bold] Permitted [/bold]
- Choosing a unique personality and sticking to it. - Having a boring personality and character.
### [bold] Not Permitted [/bold]
- Acting comepletely goddamn insane for no reason. - Having a personality that causes nothing but issues for other people as a non-antagonist. - Dont make your entire personality "being insufferable"
